dct_description_sm: This is a Elevation Surface DSM acquired through the 2009 LEAP project coordinated by the MNR. It has a 1m resolution which was derived from the LiDAR point data captured through this acquisition. The accuracy of this data was reported as an average of 0.146m with 67% within 0.1274m and 95% within 0.2076m. This elevation model includes non-ground features such as buildings and trees.
